title: PCSO Lotto Results: No winners of P381-M Grand Lotto jackpot on Nov. 18
summary: It's better luck next time for bettors aiming for the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize of over P381 million after no winners were announced in any of the major lotto jackpot draws on November 18, 2026, the…

blocks.text: It's better luck next time for bettors aiming for the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize of over P381 million after no winners were announced in any of the major lotto jackpot draws on November 18, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said Wednesday.
The Grand Lotto jackpot of P381,712,836.09 remained elusive after no one selected the correct combination of 33-44-28-03-20-36.
The last time someone won the Grand Lotto jackpot was on March 9, 2026, when a single bettor from Negros Occidental, a seafarer, took home the P45 million prize.
There were also no winners for Megalotto 6/45 whose numbers of 11-18-45-04-14-08 would have translated to a P26,266,796.56 jackpot.
Check here for the complete lotto results. —RF, GMA News
